FLIGHT HANDLING

PILOT NOTE

The gun aims separately. Simulation keeps altitude and heading assistance. It is not a full aircraft simulator.

CAMERA ZOOM OUT

1×

1× is the original view. Zoom out up to 16×. Pinch the open view, use the mouse wheel, or use the live + / − buttons.

LIVE TACTICAL VIEW · 8×–16×

From 8×: targets, fire zones, course, and distance. From 12×: sector grid and region information. Flight and gun controls stay active. There is no automatic pilot.

THE LOW ISLANDS

21 islands · Procedural terrain

The first supply mission remains on the home island. Fly beyond it to explore the new outposts.

Quality changes apply at once. Target-device frame rates have not been measured.

CONTROLS

W A S D Fly MOUSE Aim / fire

↑ ↓ ← → Aim / fire SHIFT Boost

SPACE / E Take off / land ESC Menu

H Hide interface M Sound

Gamepad: left stick to fly, right stick to aim and fire, A for flight, LB for boost, Menu for options.

Touch: left stick to fly, right stick to aim and fire. Pinch two fingers on the open view to zoom. Stick touches do not change zoom. Use the flight button to take off or land.

Flight mode and zoom are saved on this browser when storage is available.
